dict.string: 开：底座模式，游戏输出 1600×900，画面更清楚，但 GPU 负担更大、更容易发热掉帧。关：掌机模式 1280×720。下次打开游戏时生效（正在运行的话先从后台划掉）。 On: docked mode, the game outputs 1600×900 for a sharper picture, with more GPU load and more heat. Off: handheld mode, 1280×720. Takes effect the next time the game starts (close it from the app switcher first if it is running).
